name: tooltip
description: A source-owned Dioxus tooltip backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; hover/focus/Escape handling and ARIA wiring remain inside adico-primitives. Positioning is CSS-only via data-side/data-align attributes, matching the real upstream implementation (no portal or JS positioning engine).
documentation.accessibility: `TooltipTrigger` is described by a `role="tooltip"` `TooltipContent` via `aria-describedby`, per the WAI-ARIA APG Tooltip pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/tooltip.rs`); positioned relative to the trigger by the shared `Positioner`.
documentation.keyboard: Shown on hover or focus of the trigger, dismissed on Escape or on blur/mouse-leave.
